name: Beatrix Goldcrest

goals.text: wed their heir into a great house

memories: Lowri Wolfholt took my daughter into House Wolfholt.
The Treason of Sunstone: A man posing as a merchant comes to Sunstone with letters from Beatrix Goldcrest of House Goldcrest, and leaves without them.
The Treason of Sunstone: House Goldcrest sends gold to Sunstone hidden in wine casks. Odette Dale buys horses and says they're for the tourney.
The Treason of Sunstone: Mabel Highfell hears about the horses and the casks, and invites Odette Dale to spend the winter at Highfell. Odette Dale claims to have a fever.
The Treason of Sunstone: Odette Dale finally rides to Highfell, between two lines of House Highfell's spearmen.
The Treason of Sunstone: The letters from Beatrix Goldcrest are read aloud, and then Mabel Highfell has Odette Dale beheaded in the yard at Highfell.
voice: greedy, ambitious lord of House Goldcrest; speaks like a proud noble
